def bgpath_candidate(M,target,bg,corecenter,tie='global',core='global'):
 comps=source_components(M,target,bg,conn=4);R,Cn=M.shape
 allowed=(M==target)|(M==bg);dirs=[(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]
 gd=[]
 for cells,co,_ in comps:
  d=np.full(M.shape,10**9,int);q=deque()
  for r,c in cells:d[r,c]=0;q.append((r,c))
  while q:
   r,c=q.popleft()
   for dr,dc in dirs:
    u,v=r+dr,c+dc
    if 0<=u<R and 0<=v<Cn and allowed[u,v] and d[u,v]>d[r,c]+1:
     d[u,v]=d[r,c]+1;q.append((u,v))
  gd.append(d)
 labels=[co.most_common(1)[0][0] for _,co,_ in comps]
 totals=Counter();[totals.update(co) for _,co,_ in comps];glob=totals.most_common(1)[0][0]
 pred=M.copy()
 for r,c in zip(*np.where(M==target)):
  r=int(r);c=int(c)
  if abs(r-corecenter[0])<=1 and abs(c-corecenter[1])<=1 and (r,c)!=corecenter:continue
  ds=[int(d[r,c]) for d in gd];md=min(ds);ids=[i for i,d in enumerate(ds) if d==md]

  if (r,c)==corecenter and core=='global': color=glob
  elif tie=='global' and len({labels[i] for i in ids})>1: color=glob
  else: color=labels[ids[0]]
  pred[r,c]=color

def center_seed_geodesic(M,target,bg,out,corecenter):
 comps=source_components(M,target,bg,conn=4);R,Cn=M.shape;dirs=[(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)]
 allgd=[]
 for cells,co,_ in comps:
  # medoid by Manhattan sum within source component
  med=min(cells,key=lambda p:sum(abs(p[0]-u)+abs(p[1]-v) for u,v in cells))
  d=np.full(M.shape,10**9,int);q=deque([med]);d[med]=0
  allowed=np.isin(M,[target])
  # permit this component source cells as traversal
  compmask=np.zeros(M.shape,bool)
  for p in cells: compmask[p]=True
  while q:
   r,c=q.popleft()
   for dr,dc in dirs:
    u,v=r+dr,c+dc
    if 0<=u<R and 0<=v<Cn and (allowed[u,v] or compmask[u,v]) and d[u,v]>d[r,c]+1:
     d[u,v]=d[r,c]+1;q.append((u,v))
  allgd.append(d)
 labels=[co.most_common(1)[0][0] for _,co,_ in comps]
 pred=M.copy()
 for r,c in zip(*np.where(M==target)):
  r=int(r);c=int(c)
  if abs(r-corecenter[0])<=1 and abs(c-corecenter[1])<=1 and (r,c)!=(corecenter):continue
  ds=[int(d[r,c]) for d in allgd];md=min(ds);ids=[i for i,d in enumerate(ds) if d==md]
  if md<10**9: pred[r,c]=labels[ids[0]]
 return pred,allgd,comps
